description: Backend Cloud Run platform request-log 5xx counter grouped by HTTP method and a generic path family: optional version plus at most three complete lowercase path segments. Invalid segments end the family; hosts and query parameters are not labels.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND logName="projects/based-hardware/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.status >= 500 AND httpRequest.status < 600

labels.description: Bounded HTTP method; combined with route for route-family identity.
Optional version plus up to three complete lowercase path segments; stops before digits, uppercase or other invalid characters. Lowercase slugs can remain labels.
